title: DID Service Credential
description: General-purpose scoped delegation credential for service relationships between DIDs. Defines what a delegate is authorized to do, within what constraints, and how they are compensated. Domain-agnostic — applicable to fleet management, code review, monitoring, or any delegated service.

serviceType.description: Service domain identifier following namespace:type pattern (e.g., 'hive:management', 'agent:code-review', 'infra:monitoring').

delegator.description: DID of the party granting authority (the credential issuer).

delegate.description: DID of the party receiving delegated authority (the credential subject).

permissions.description: Boolean flags defining what the delegate is authorized to do. Keys are domain-specific permission names.

constraints.description: Quantitative limits on delegated authority. Keys are domain-specific constraint names; values are numbers or strings defining upper bounds, allowed lists, or rate limits.

tier.description: Named permission tier summarizing the delegation level (e.g., 'monitor', 'standard', 'advanced', 'admin'). Semantics are domain-specific.

compensation.description: How the delegate is compensated for service.

model.description: Compensation model governing payment timing and conditions.

rate.description: Compensation rate in the specified currency (e.g., sats per action, sats per month).

acceptableMints.description: Acceptable Cashu mint URLs for escrow ticket redemption.

scope.description: Additional metadata bounding the delegation scope.

allowedSchemas.description: Schema identifiers the delegate is authorized to execute (supports glob patterns).

targetResources.description: Identifiers of resources the delegate may act upon (e.g., node IDs, service endpoints).

maxDailyActions.description: Maximum number of actions the delegate may perform per day.
